text: dsh-vision-subagent（DSH Web 插件）：为纯文本模型提供图片理解能力。它注册视觉代理工具，并为 Web 输入框接入粘贴图片后的自动分析。主要功能包括读取工作区图片、把图片分析委托给独立视觉路由、按提问聚焦截图内容、在聊天中展示图片缩略图和分析说明，以及取回原始图片文件。适合需要让文本模型识别截图、照片、图表或比较多张图片的 DSH 用户。使用前需配置可处理图像的 provider 和 model，并使用 DSH Web。

dsh-vision-subagent lets text-only DSH agents analyze workspace or pasted images through a configured vision route. It provides question-guided analysis, thumbnails, and original file retrieval for screenshots, photos, or charts. Configure a vision-capable provider and model.
想让只能处理文字的 DSH 模型读懂截图里的报错。
如何把多张图片交给独立视觉模型比较？
希望在 Web 输入框粘贴图片后自动分析并结合我的问题回答。
我需要从聊天中取回粘贴图片的原始文件用于后续处理。
DSH 能否把图片分析和主会话上下文分开？
让 DSH 根据我对图表或界面截图的提问提取视觉信息。
Can a text-only DSH agent answer questions about screenshots?
I want pasted images analyzed automatically in the web chat.
dsh-vision-subagent 的功能「读取工作区图片」：vision_agent 接收本地图片路径和具体问题，把图片保存为持久附件并交给视觉子代理分析，返回文本结论。
dsh-vision-subagent 的功能「粘贴图片自动分析」：Web 输入框发送粘贴图片时，主机端保存图片附件，并按用户草稿问题调用配置的视觉路由；分析文本随消息提交。
dsh-vision-subagent 的功能「图片聊天展示」：聊天记录将桥接附件呈现为缩略图，并在灯箱中查看对应的视觉分析内容。
dsh-vision-subagent 的功能「取回原始图片」：对聊天中的持久图片引用调用 vision_image_fetch，可将原始图片写入会话工作区的 .dsh-vision/ 目录。

dsh-vision-subagent README · dsh-vision-subagent：[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: delegate image reading to a **one-shot subagent** running on a separately configured **vision route** (MiniMax / Kimi / any OpenAI-compatible provider). Image bytes and the vision model's intermediate context **never enter the main session** — only the final text answer comes back.

dsh-vision-subagent README · Why a subagent：- **Context isolation**: large screenshots and multi-image comparisons never occupy the main model's window
- **Multi-turn visual reasoning**: the child can call read_image on more workspace files before answering
- **Cost & route separation**: vision calls bill on the MiniMax/Kimi route; the main model only reasons

dsh-vision-subagent README · Quick start：`sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-vision-subagent
`

Then edit `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

`yaml
- insert:
    - id: vision-subagent
      name: 'dsh-vision-subagent'
      config:
        provider: kimi-coding   # or minimax-cn / a hand-declared route
        model: k3               # or MiniMax-M3 / MiniMax-VL-01
`

dsh-vision-subagent README · Quick start：Restart `dsh web`, open a new session, and ask: "Look at ~/Desktop/error.png — what is the error?" The model calls `vision_agent(images=[...], question=...)` on its own.

dsh-vision-subagent README · Paste images into the composer (Codex-style)：The Web composer accepts pasted/dropped images natively. On send, the client plugin uploads them to the host endpoint, which:

dsh-vision-subagent README · Paste images into the composer (Codex-style)：1. validates the session and stores the images as durable attachments (bounded by deployment limits)
2. runs ONE vision-route analysis on an isolated context (image bytes never enter the main session), **guided by your draft message** — the analysis focuses on what your words target (error text for a debugging ask, outfit details for a styling ask) instead of describing everything generically
3. sends only the analysis text along with your message — the main model answers immediately, no tool call needed

dsh-vision-subagent README · Paste images into the composer (Codex-style)：In the chat history your bubble shows only your own words plus thumbnails; the analysis lives in the lightbox that opens when you click a thumbnail, never duplicated inline. Need the original bytes later (image editing, pixel-level inspection)? The durable message links let the model call `vision_image_fetch` to materialize the full-fidelity file into the workspace's `.dsh-vision/` directory.

dsh-vision-subagent README · Paste images into the composer (Codex-style)：On failure (timeout, route error) the message is not sent and the composer draft is preserved. This channel complements the vision_agent tool: pasted images take the automatic path, while workspace files are read by the model calling the tool itself.

dsh-vision-subagent README · MiniMax / Kimi vision models：| Provider | baseURL | Vision models | Key env |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kimi (Moonshot) | https://api.moonshot.cn/v1 | k3 / kimi-k3 / moonshot-v1-8k-vision-preview | MOONSHOT_API_KEY |
| MiniMax | https://api.minimaxi.com/v1 | MiniMax-VL-01 | MINIMAX_API_KEY |
| MiniMax CN | (built-in llm-pi-ai minimax-cn route) | MiniMax-M3 | MINIMAX_CN_API_KEY |

dsh-vision-subagent README · MiniMax / Kimi vision models：If a route already exists in Settings/Models (e.g. kimi-coding, minimax-cn), the plugin config only names provider + model — the key stays in the route's credential reference. The plugin itself never touches secrets.

dsh-vision-subagent README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| enabled | true | Master switch |
| provider / model | '' (dormant) | Vision route; must be set together |
| subagentProvider | spawn | ctx.subagents provider |
| maxDepth | 1 | Absolute delegation-depth cap for the spawned child; 1 lets the vision child run but forbids further delegation (0 would reject the child itself — a top-level agent's child is depth 1) |
| maxImages | 4 | Images per call |
| maxImageBytes | 10 MiB | Per-image byte cap |
| maxPromptChars | 8000 | Question length cap |
| maxOutputChars | 32000 | Returned text truncation |
| allowRemoteUrls | false | Reserved (v0.1 supports local paths only) |
| allowOutsideWorkspace | false | Workspace containment bypass |
| extraAllowedRoots | [] | Extra allowed image roots |
| guidance | '' | Extra instructions appended to the child prompt |

dsh-vision-subagent README · Security model：- Keys live only in the vision route's credential reference (env); the plugin accepts no plaintext secrets
- Local images default to the session workspace; symlinks are rejected; reads are byte-capped
- The child runs with maxDepth: 1 (runs, but cannot delegate further) and instructions forbid file modification and shell use
- `vision_image_fetch` writes only under the session workspace's `.dsh-vision/` with self-generated content-hashed filenames; no caller-controlled path segment reaches the disk

dsh-vision-subagent README · Architecture：`
Main model (text-only)
   └─ vision_agent(images, question) ──┐
        │ 1. admission: ext / containment / symlink / byte cap
        │ 2. ctx.attachments.saveImage → durable content-addressed refs
        │ 3. ctx.subagents.start('spawn', { agentOptions: {provider, model} })
        ▼
One-shot subagent (MiniMax/Kimi vision route, own context)
   └─ final text ──► main session (only this message enters main context)
`

dsh-vision-subagent README · Architecture：The plugin consumes harness services structurally (duck-typed) and is rc-version tolerant. Runtime dependencies: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools (defineTool) and @deepseek-ai/schemastery (config schema) only.

dsh-vision-subagent README · Roadmap：- [x] Web paste bridge: composer images auto-trigger vision analysis (v0.2)
- [x] Context-aware paste analysis: your draft message steers the vision focus; bubble stays clean (v0.3)
- [x] `vision_image_fetch`: materialize pasted originals into `.dsh-vision/` for editing (v0.3)
